nodes.title: User Sync Architecture Revisit
nodes.description: Revisit the client-side query+mutation pattern for syncing Clerk users into Convex. Current approach runs a Convex query on every page load for authenticated users. Evaluate: Clerk webhook handled entirely as a Convex HTTP action, or a Convex auth trigger, to guarantee sync fires exactly once on sign-up with no client-side overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: Sync fires exactly once on user creation with no per-page-load queries
No unauthenticated mutations callable from outside the system
Solution works in local dev without ngrok or manual steps
Existing users table data preserved

nodes.title: Consolidate Order Design Intake Validation Rules
nodes.description: Apply the A-03 split to lib/order.ts, lib/design.ts, and lib/intake.ts. Convex orders.ts, designs.ts, and intakes.ts import constants and checks from the new rules modules. Single source for team-name, sport, quantity, design title, and brief caps.
acceptanceCriteria: rules.ts plus form.ts split done for order, design, and intake lib modules
convex/orders.ts, designs.ts, intakes.ts import constants from new rules modules
no duplicated validation constants remain across lib and convex
all existing tests pass
A-02 smoke tests still pass
nodes.humanQuestion: Hold off until we finalize order UI

nodes.title: Extract Form Hooks From Large Components
nodes.description: Optional and deferred. Extract use*Form hooks (state, validation glue, payload building, submission status) out of JerseyRunSetup (686 lines), IntakeForm (678), JerseyRunPublicForm (594), DesignForm (589), and OrderForm (544). Only worth doing if the files still feel unwieldy after A-03..A-05 land - re-measure first.
acceptanceCriteria: after A-03..A-05 land, re-measure line counts for each form component and confirm extraction is still worth doing
if confirmed, useJerseyRunForm, useIntakeForm, useJerseyRunPublicForm, useDesignForm, useOrderForm hooks live in sibling files
each form component shrinks to ~300 lines of JSX plus onSubmit wiring
all existing tests pass

nodes.title: Design Page Motion and Polish
nodes.description: Deferred polish pass: tasteful motion, hover, transitions across the design page + editor. Starts with a human design discussion before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Human design direction agreed first (needs-human)
Motion/hover/transition polish applied; respects reduced-motion
No functional regressions

nodes.title: Wipe Stale Dev Design and Capture Track D Screenshots
nodes.description: One pre-D-01 design blocks the schema push, so snap.mjs has no backend: D-01/D-02/D-03 all shipped without screenshots. Wipe it, push, re-snap all three.
acceptanceCriteria: Stale designs row removed (human-approved) and npx convex dev --once pushes clean
snap.mjs captures /portal/designs/[id] and /admin/designs/[id] for D-01, D-02 and D-03
Obvious visual breakage found in those screenshots fixed or filed
docs/review/<nodeId>/ populated at 375/768/1280 light+dark
nodes.humanQuestion: May we delete the one pre-D-01 design on the dev deployment so the schema can push (screenshots are blocked for all of Track D)?

nodes.title: Run Surface Lock Controls
nodes.description: R-06 shipped lock/unlock mutations with no UI. The captain run surfaces (run setup, run responses) still offer Manage-run affordances on a locked run and expose no lock/unlock control, so a captain can neither lock deliberately nor see why a run stopped accepting edits.
acceptanceCriteria: captain/admin can lock a run from the run surface
a locked run shows a locked badge and read-only run settings
admin unlock (and pre-deadline captain unlock) is reachable from the UI

nodes.title: Jersey Breakdown Derivations + Order Detail Roster/Size View
nodes.description: Add lib/jerseyBreakdown.ts (pure derivations over listOrderEntries) and render collected jerseys as name/number/size per design on the order detail page, plus a combined size breakdown UI component. Foundation for the responses-page views.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/jerseyBreakdown.ts owns the roster-by-design + size-tally derivations
Order detail shows name/number/size per design via listOrderEntries
Combined size breakdown is a UI-only derived component
Per-design lines reconcile with countsByRun; no regressions

nodes.title: Captain Responses Page — Multi-View Breakdown (By Roster / By Fan)
nodes.description: Add a view switcher on the captain responses page over the same listOrderEntries data: By roster (reuses C-01) and By fan (email to ordered jerseys), plus the combined size breakdown. Adds only the jerseysByFan derivation.
acceptanceCriteria: Responses page has a By roster / By fan view switcher
By roster reuses C-01's per-design breakdown component
By fan groups by normalized submitter email to jersey lines
Existing detailed table remains; no regressions
